subject: Token economics & next steps — ClearPay discovery
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@clearpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Token economics & next steps — ClearPay discovery

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and a proposed short list of next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of pain points you confirmed:
- High variability in inference spend driven by peak hours and long token prompts (customer messages + context history).
- Need predictable unit economics for Q4 pilots — finance is tightening trial budgets.
- SLA and latency sensitivity for customer-facing flows (~200–400ms p95 target), so any batching must not degrade UX.
- Desire for a measurable ROI case before committing to longer-term capacity.

What we propose as levers to test in a 6–8 week pilot (recommended minimum scope):
1) Batching + smart prefix/KV caching for synchronous flows — expect 20–35% effective token cost reduction for the most common flow patterns (higher when history prefixes are repetitive).
2) Model variants: run 2 models in parallel (high-quality vs quantized fast variant) with routing policy for lower-cost fallbacks during spikes — potential 1.5x–2.5x throughput improvement for quantized paths.
3) Dedicated burst pool (short reservation) for predictable peak capacity while keeping baseline costs in hosted mode.
4) Prompt engineering + truncation guidance to cut average tokens per call; quick wins often reduce tokens by ~10–20%.

Initial commercial framing (pilot-level):
- Target pilot cap: ~$18k–25k / month (we'll align exact numbers below).
- Goal: demonstrate >=25% net cost improvement on your two highest-volume flows while meeting latency SLOs.
- Success criteria: cost per successful transaction, p95 latency <= 400ms, and no loss in NPS-critical responses.

Attachments: I dropped a one-pager on batching and a spend snapshot you sent (clearpay_spend_snapshot.csv).

Next steps I suggest now:
- I will send a trimmed pilot scope and two pricing options (hosted capped pilot vs short dedicated reservation).
- Schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with your engineering team to validate latency trade-offs (can do Wed/Thu next week).
- If procurement needs a formal SOW, we can provide a 1-page SOW and standard security addendum.

Can you confirm the budget ceiling your finance team is comfortable with for a pilot, and whether we should include your security contact on the next call?

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Token economics & next steps — ClearPay discovery

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and the batching primer. A few quick items from my side: 

1) Budget: Our finance lead signaled a firm cap of $20k for any pilot that starts in Q4 unless we can show a clear staged approval path. So if you can scope a pilot that fits under $20k with measurable checkpoints, procurement will greenlight it faster.
2) Security: please add our InfoSec contact (secops@clearpay.com) to any document exchange. They will want SOC 2 Type II evidence and a brief of where data is processed.
3) Engineering: we can commit to a 30-min deep-dive next Wednesday 09/22 at 10:00am PT.

We like the two-track idea (hosted optimized + quantized fallback) but need the pilot to show cost improvements without risking customer-facing latency. Can you share a tighter 4–6 week scope that stays under $20k?

Appreciate it — Alyssa

Alyssa Gomez
Head of Product Operations, ClearPay
alyssa.gomez@clearpay.com | +1 (415) 777-8800

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Token economics & next steps — ClearPay discovery (finance cap $20k)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Alyssa's reply. Key constraints: firm pilot cap $20k, requires SOC2 evidence for procurement, and they want the 30-min deep-dive 9/22 at 10am PT.

Questions for pricing + delivery: 
- Can we fit an actionable 4–6 week pilot under $20k that still demonstrates >=25% unit-cost improvement for their top two flows? My thought: prioritize batching + prompt truncation on hosted with an optional 2-week quantized fallback test window (metered separately).
- If not, is there a stripped scope we can offer (one flow only) that hits the budget and keeps the ROI signal?

Also flagging Ben for quick latency/ops notes — we'll need to document expected p95 impact and fallback routing plan for the engineering deep-dive.

If you want, I can draft two slim options (A = single-flow host-optimized under $20k; B = two-flow hosted + short quantized test slightly over $20k) and send to Alyssa tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@clearpay.com>, secops@clearpay.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token economics & next steps — ClearPay discovery

Alyssa — thanks for the clarity. Quick follow-up and a concrete pilot proposal that fits the $20k cap.

Proposed 5-week pilot (scoped to sit under $20k):
- Scope: Optimize your primary customer-message flow (Flow A) only. Includes: batching + prefix/KV caching for repeated contexts, prompt truncation playbook, routing to a quantized fallback for spike windows (fallback enabled for 2 non-consecutive weeks, capped usage).
- Deliverables: batching config + ops runbook, 2 prompt templates that reduce tokens on average, dashboard with cost delta and latency (daily), and a short SOW + security addendum.
- Commercials (hosted capped pilot): $18,500 flat for the 5-week pilot. We will meter overage but cap any overrun to prior written approval.
- Success target: >=20% reduction in effective cost per successful transaction for Flow A while keeping p95 latency <= 400ms.

If this looks good I will:
1) Send an SOW + SOC2 evidence pack to secops@clearpay.com and Alyssa.
2) Book the technical deep-dive for Wed 09/22 10:00am PT (invitation will go out in a separate calendar invite).
3) Provide a one-page decision checklist so finance can sign off quickly.

If you'd prefer to test two flows, we can expand scope — rough price for two-flow hosted pilot with the same deliverables would be $27k for 6 weeks (we will only proceed if finance approves).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Jonas Weber
